question: Could you find out the average percentage of the total lifetime sales (LTV) that occur in the first 7 and 30 days after a customer's initial purchase? Also, include the average total lifetime sales (LTV). Please exclude customers with zero lifetime sales. The 7- and 30-day periods should be based on the exact number of hours-minutes-seconds, not calendar days.
sql:
-- Final query with rounding for readability
WITH customer_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    MIN(payment_date) as first_payment_date,
    SUM(amount) as total_ltv
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_early_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    p.customer_id,
    p.amount,
    p.payment_date,
    cs.first_payment_date,
    cs.total_ltv,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.payment_date - cs.first_payment_date)) / 3600.0 as hours_since_first
  FROM payment p
  JOIN customer_stats cs ON p.customer_id = cs.customer_id
),
customer_percentages AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    total_ltv,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN hours_since_first >= 0 AND hours_since_first < 168 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as sales_7days,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN hours_since_first >= 0 AND hours_since_first < 720 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as sales_30days
  FROM customer_early_sales
  GROUP BY customer_id, total_ltv
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(sales_7days / total_ltv * 100.0), 2) as avg_pct_7days,
  ROUND(AVG(sales_30days / total_ltv * 100.0), 2) as avg_pct_30days,
  ROUND(AVG(total_ltv), 2) as avg_total_ltv
FROM customer_percentages
WHERE total_ltv > 0

{"sql": "-- Build the full query step by step
-- First, get per-customer stats
WITH customer_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    MIN(payment_date) as first_payment_date,
    SUM(amount) as total_ltv
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_early_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    p.customer_id,
    p.amount,
    p.payment_date,
    cs.first_payment_date,
    cs.total_ltv,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.payment_date - cs.first_payment_date)) / 3600.0 as hours_since_first
  FROM payment p
  JOIN customer_stats cs ON p.customer_id = cs.customer_id
),
customer_percentages AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    total_ltv,
    -- First 7 days = 168 hours
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN hours_since_first >= 0 AND hours_since_first < 168 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as sales_7days,
    -- First 30 days = 720 hours
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN hours_since_first >= 0 AND hours_since_first < 720 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as sales_30days
  FROM customer_early_sales
  GROUP BY customer_id, total_ltv
)
SELECT 
  AVG(sales_7days / total_ltv * 100.0) as avg_pct_7days,
  AVG(sales_30days / total_ltv * 100.0) as avg_pct_30days,
  AVG(total_ltv) as avg_total_ltv
FROM customer_percentages
WHERE total_ltv > 0"}
